BlackRock signed a joint venture with Humana (NYSE: HUM) to manage and operate nearly 150 CareWell Senior Primary Care clinics. BlackRock's HPS Investment Partners will acquire Walsh Carson Anderson & Stowe's current equity stake, valued at around $2.8b.
Dastex, backed by The Riverside Co., acquired Abovo, a Swiss distributor of cleanroom consumables.
GTCR and Elliott Investment Management are in advanced talks to buy car insurance software provider CCC Intelligent Solutions (Nasdaq: CCC), per Bloomberg.
HR Path, a French portfolio company of Ardian, acquired SnapAI, a provider of regulatory compliance solutions.
Innovative Refrigeration Systems, backed by CCMP Growth, acquired QuickFreeze, a Fort Wayne, Ind.-based maker of blast-chilling products.
Ithaca Holdings is in talks to acquire dating app Bumble (Nasdaq: BMBL) for around $1b, per the WSJ. Blackstone holds around a 14% stake, stemming from its 2019 buyout.
One Equity Partners agreed to buy IT group Nexora from Ireland's DCC Energy (LSE: DCC) for $725m.
Sopris Capital acquired Blackford Analysis, a U.K. provider of AI orchestration for medical imaging, from Bayer.
AirTrunk, an Australian data center operator owned by Blackstone and CPP Investment Board, is delaying a $1.5b REIT IPO until 2027, per Bloomberg.

Aspen Neuroscience, a San Diego-based developer of stem cell therapies for Parkinson's disease, filed for an IPO (Nasdaq: ASPE). It has raised $380m from OrbiMed (13.1%), Arch Venture Partners (12.3%), Gilead (8.4%), and others.

Bambusa Therapeutics, a Boston-based developer of bispecific antibodies for inflammatory diseases, filed for an IPO (Nasdaq: BBTX). Phase 2 company has raised $142m from Salvia (24.3%), RA Capital (11.3%), and others.
Base Electron, a power infrastructure company, said that it confidentially filed for an IPO.

City Therapeutics, a Cambridge, Mass.-based developer of RNAi medicines, set IPO terms to 9.7m shares at $17-$19. It would have a $1b fully diluted value at the midpoint (Nasdaq: CTY). Has raised $240m from Arch (35%), Fidelity (10%), and others.

OPay, an Africa-focused payments company founded by Norway's Opera, filed for an IPO that Renaissance Capital estimates could raise $500m (NYSE: OPAY). H1 2026: $91m net income on $467m revenue. Has raised over $270m from SoftBank, IDG Capital, HSG, GSR Ventures, and Source Code Capital.

TRex Bio, a South SF-based developer of precision immunoregulatory medicines, raised $117m in its IPO. It priced at the low end of its $14-$16 range and listed on the Nasdaq (TRXB). Had raised over $220m; Eli Lilly buying back in via the IPO.

Carnegie Learning acquired Ethiqly, a San Diego-based digital writing hub created in collaboration with IDEO, from Owl Ventures.

IonQ (NYSE: IONQ) agreed to buy Elisity, a San Jose, Calif. provider of identity-based network microsegmentation, for up to $1.3b in stock, per the WSJ. Elisity raised $78m from Insight Partners, Chevron Technology Ventures, TCV, and others.

Drilling Tools International (Nasdaq: DTI) agreed to acquire Saltire, a Scottish provider of rental drilling tools, for around $80m in cash and stock.
Lineage (NYSE: LINE) hired Drake Star to sell transportation management system subsidiary Turvo, per Axios Pro.
Roche (SWX: ROP) signed an obesity drug licensing deal with VC-backed Chinese biotech Rona Therapeutics, including $100m upfront and up to $1.06b in earnouts.
Solventum (NYSE: SOLV) is seeking to sell its Health Information Systems business for between $5.5b and $7b, per Axios Pro.
Steris (NYSE: STE) agreed to buy Xodus Medical, a New Kensington, Pa.-based maker of surgical products, for $2.1b.

Starbucks said it has no plans to buy Chipotle, sending Starbucks stock up and Chipotle stock down. The FT had previously reported on a possible deal that would have been the largest-ever restaurant sector merger.
